about_the_game:
🌼Remember the flowers. Lead your mole. Make the forest bloom!

Memoroute VR is a delightful memory-based puzzle game reborn in virtual reality, now available as a DLC for Table Party.

Up to 4 players can join the fun, making it a perfect party game for all ages.

Each player receives a mission card and must remember the positions of 8 types of flower tiles hidden in the bushes — each appearing in pairs.

Lift the bushes with your own hands, discover the matching flowers, and guide your mole to its destination.

Quick thinking and sharp memory are the keys to success.

But this isn’t just any memory game — VR transforms it into a fully interactive experience.

You'll physically move your hands to peek into the undergrowth, and place signposts along your route.

The cute mole characters and the vibrant garden environment bring the gameplay to life like never before.

🌸 Game Features

- Multiplayer support for up to 4 players

- Fully interactive VR controls: lift bushes, find flowers, place signs

- Mission-driven gameplay that tests memory and strategy

- Quick, fun rounds perfect for parties and families

Get ready to dig deep, think fast, and blossom in Memoroute VR, only on Table Party!
